params.body:
The main navigation wrapped its labels in the middle: "Eigen wagenpark" became "Eigen" above "wagenpark", and "Nuttige links" did the same.

## What was measured

In the browser against production, at a 1084px window, 28 September 2026:

- The bar **fitted** horizontally: 1054px of items in 1084px. The problem was not the bar but the label, which inherits `white-space: normal` and breaks inside its own item.
- That pushed the bar from **64px to 91px**, left each icon hanging on the first line above half a word, and put single-word items on a different baseline from the broken ones.
- Forbidding the break costs width: the same nine items then ask **1205px** where 1054px is available.
- The icons pay for it. They repeat the word beside them, so below 1250px they go: **890px** of items, the bar back to **64px**, and 126px to spare.
- The alert button is `position: fixed` against the right edge and **covered the last item**: it starts at 1052px while "Inzichten" ran to 1069px.

## Why not scroll the bar

Four items carry a submenu (Biedingen, Administratie, Nuttige links, Beheer). An overflow container would clip those, which is the same trap `.wagenlijst-overflow` documents twice in this file: it was taken off `overflow-x: auto` once because it clipped the quick-actions dropdown, and once because it broke the sticky header.

## Verified

In the browser against production at 1084px: one line, no label broken, 64px high, and the button clear of the last item. `StylesheetSyntaxTest` and `BuildContractTest` green, and `npm run build` passes.

## Not in here

While measuring this I found a second and worse defect on the same screen, which this PR deliberately does not touch because the fix is a design decision rather than a correction:

**The row actions are unreachable between 768px and 1429px.** The vehicle list table needs 1429px inside a 992px container. `html` and `body` carry `overflow-x: hidden`, so the 391px overhang is clipped with no scrollbar: `canScrollRight: false`. The cell holding view, copy, edit and delete sits at 1305 to 1475, fully off-screen, visible width 0. The mobile card layout only starts at `max-width: 767px`, so every window in that band is affected, which is most laptops.

Hiding columns does not recover it: without the button column the table still needs 1283px, and without "gepubliceerd" it gets worse rather than better, because the freed width redistributes. Every column already sits at its content minimum. So the choice is between letting the page scroll horizontally in that band, or raising the breakpoint of the card layout that already exists for phones. That is a product decision and it is written up for you rather than guessed at here.
params.title: A menu label is one phrase
